title: Years of habit history
description: Records, changes of goals and an overview of past periods. The history can be exported to a file and checked after a transfer to another device.

blocks.text: After several years of use, the value of a tracker lies in the records it has accumulated. An export makes it possible to keep them and view them in another tool. That is a specific, useful capability that one review author singles out.

quote.text: Configurable, easy to use, makes it fast to track anything daily. With great export functionality my years of tacking are both preserved and available for analysis in other tools. Absolutely recommend for anyone wanting to have daily reminders or historical records.

blocks.text: Export the dates, the values and the habit names into a readable format. Make a backup and verify the transfer to a new device. After a restore, show which periods and habits came across and where gaps were found.

Restore a real archive on a clean device and open the export outside the app. The old names, the corrected dates and the finished habits all have to survive. The promise that “data will never disappear” should be replaced by a restore that can be verified.
